simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דַּיָּה (H1772) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דַּיָּה (dayâh) means a falcon (from its rapid flight) First listed occurrence: Deut 14 13.

definitions.full: H1772. dayyah [ דַּיָּה ] noun feminine id. — frequenting ruins, compare Di l.c. ; דַּיּוֺת Isa 34:15 (on הַדַּיָּה Deut 14:13 compare foregoing).
